build_HydraModel: build a HydraModel with a backbone and output heads for molecular property prediction
create_BackboneInterface_subclass: create a subclass of BackboneInterface implementing forward and inference methods for a new model backbone
create_HeadInterface_subclass: create a subclass of HeadInterface implementing forward to predict targets from backbone embeddings
run_HydraModel_forward: run the HydraModel forward pass on AtomicData to predict all output properties across heads
refactor_HydraModel_add_tasks: refactor the HydraModel add_tasks method to dynamically add inference-only tasks like forces or stress
